title: Lines of light
summary: Thin lines of light on near-black and deep teal haze: every 1-3 px line has a white core, a red echo offset one way, a blue echo the other and a soft lilac glow. A red dot fires the first line, red marks a cause and blue the result arriving; nothing appears until a line reaches it. Slow eased draw-ons with a hard lock, wide tracked Michroma capitals that land orange, burn red and cool to white, IBM Plex Mono for small UI text.
